tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Rank pages of visible documents for a query. Returns doc_id, page, snippet.

tools.name: ask_documents
tools.description: Cited answer to a question from the documents (verified claims only).

tools.name: get_firm_profile
tools.description: Accepted firm rules (board cadence, sign-off thresholds, screening criteria...) with sources.

tools.name: firm_profile_gaps
tools.description: Firm-knowledge terms with no accepted value yet, so the user can be asked or documents mined.

tools.name: extract_firm_knowledge
tools.description: Extract firm rules from one document into the pending review queue (cited).

tools.name: list_facts
tools.description: Verified facts, each with source. Filter by entity.

tools.name: list_alerts
tools.description: Open alerts from the proactive inbox (covenant breaches and similar), with fact ids.

tools.name: open_funding_rounds
tools.description: Private placements (SEC Form D) for an issuer name in a quarter. Self-reported amounts; None = Indefinite.

tools.name: open_entity_lookup
tools.description: Identify a company: GLEIF LEI records and Wikidata candidates, each with a source URL.

tools.name: open_macro_series
tools.description: Latest FRED observation for a series id (e.g. DGS10), with source URL.

tools.name: open_deal_leads
tools.description: 8-K filings mentioning a merger agreement in a date range (leads only; read terms from the filing).

tools.name: open_news
tools.description: Headlines from a news RSS feed (bbc_business, prnewswire_financial), optional text filter; links only.

tools.name: open_sanctions_screen
tools.description: Screen a name against an OpenSanctions list (default us_ofac_sdn). A miss is NOT a clearance. Non-commercial data licence.

tools.name: open_13f_holdings
tools.description: Top 13F holdings of a manager (name match) from the local quarter zip in PE_13F_ZIP.

tools.name: open_adviser_search
tools.description: Registered/exempt investment advisers by name from the local SEC roster zip in PE_ADV_ZIP (PE fund counts, private-fund assets).

workflows.name: build_firm_profile
workflows.description: Mine one document for firm rules, then report what is still unknown.
